LESSON: HADITH ON SWALAH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH
Topic 4.1: Hadith on swalah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on swalah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
